summary: Synchronizes vehicle-derived dashboard display state onto a D3D device (this+0x1100) through its vtable method at offset 200 (0xC8). When the vehicle state flags at a2+412 have no display bit set ((flags & 0xE0000) == 0), disables the display (this+0x14F0 = 0) and issues D3D call 28 with argument 0. Otherwise enables the display and lazily pushes changed values: a packed 16-bit dashboard combination (from a2+392/394/396) via D3D call 34, three floats (from a2+400/404/408) via calls 38/36/37, and the state-flag-derived mode (switch on a2+412: 0x20000->3, 0x40000->1, 0x80000->2, else the raw vehicle pointer) via call 35 when capability bit 0x4000 at this+0x13A8 is set, or call 140 when bit 0x8000 is set, otherwise disables again. Caches all pushed values (this+0x14F4..0x1504) to skip redundant D3D calls. Called from sub_5550E0.

operations.description: Test whether vehicle state flags at a2+412 have any display bit set: (flags & 0xE0000) == 0 means no display state, taking the disable path
On the no-display path set this+0x14F0 (display enabled flag) to 0
On the no-display path call the D3D device setter (vtable offset 200) with parameter 28 and argument 0, storing the result in this+0x0
Otherwise set this+0x14F0 (display enabled flag) to 1
Pack the three 16-bit dashboard fields from vehicle a2+392/394/396 into v13
Push the packed combination only if it differs from the cached this+0x14F4
Store the packed combination into this+0x14F4 and call the D3D setter with parameter 34 and the packed value, storing the result in this+0x0
Push vehicle float at a2+404 only if it differs from cached this+0x14FC
Store a2+404 into this+0x14FC and call the D3D setter with parameter 36 and the cached float, storing the result in this+0x0
Push vehicle float at a2+408 only if it differs from cached this+0x1500
Store a2+408 into this+0x1500 and call the D3D setter with parameter 37 and the cached float, storing the result in this+0x0
Push vehicle float at a2+400 only if it differs from cached this+0x14F8
Store a2+400 into this+0x14F8 and call the D3D setter with parameter 38 and the cached float, storing the result in this+0x0
Early return if vehicle state flags at a2+412 equal the cached this+0x1504 (nothing further to push)
Cache a2+412 into this+0x1504 and map it to a mode value: 0x20000->3, 0x40000->1, 0x80000->2, default keeps the raw a2 pointer
Read capability flags this+0x13A8; if bit 0x4000 is set, push the mode via D3D setter parameter 35, storing the result in this+0x0
Else if bit 0x8000 of this+0x13A8 is set, push the mode via D3D setter parameter 140, storing the result in this+0x0
Otherwise disable the display: set this+0x14F0 to 0 and call the D3D setter with parameter 28 and argument 0, storing the result in this+0x0
Return 0 on all completion paths

clean_pseudocode: switch (a2->flags) { case 0x20000: v7 = 3; break; case 0x40000: v7 = 1; break; case 0x80000: v7 = 2; break; default: v7 = a2; break; }
